summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page that manages staff administration tasks within the HSPnet application.
purpose: Facilitates administrative operations for staff, including user session management and interaction with employment applications.

workflows.name: Employment Application Review
steps: User selects a site and discipline from dropdowns.
User sets start and end dates for filtering applications.
The user interface updates to show applications related to the selected filters.

validations.name: End Date Validation
validations.description: Ensures the end date is correctly formatted and logically valid compared to start date.

system_behavior: The page includes mechanisms to handle user session specifics and dynamically populate site and discipline dropdowns.
